basic_details.job_title: ESIC Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 30 Specialist, Senior Resident and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interviews at ESIC Hospital, Vannarpettai, Tirunelveli are on 27 November 2026 and 16 December 2026. Registration and document verification run from 9.00 AM to 10.30 AM in the Conference Hall, 1st Floor of the hospital. Advertisement No. 05 of 2026 of the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) is a rolling advertisement for 30 contract posts: Full Time/Part Time Specialist (10), Senior Resident (03 Year) (16) and Senior Resident (01 Year) at Pay level 10 (4). Consolidated remuneration is Rs.1,42,514/- for Full Time Specialist and Senior Resident (03 Year), and Rs.1,19,082/-

The notice also says that if a PG qualified doctor is not available, MBBS doctors with two years of experience, one year of it in the concerned specialty from a Government or private hospital (not a private clinic), can be selected for the 01 Year Senior Resident post at Pay level 10 (marked against Obstetrics & Gynaecology*). | The total is 30 posts: 10 + 16 + 4. Five posts are horizontally reserved for the PwBD category in identified posts. The notice says that if reserved candidates (SC, ST, OBC and EWS) are not available, vacancies will be filled by the available meritorious candidate for a period of 44 days at the sole discretion of the Appointing Authority. For Sl.No.1 (Specialist), priority will be given to Full Time Super Specialist/Full Time Specialist.

important_instructions: Full Time Specialist: contract of a minimum one year, extendable yearly on satisfactory performance up to three years, with leave at 04 days for each month of work on pro-rata basis; no private practice. Part Time Specialist: contract of one year from the date of joining, extendable annually on satisfactory performance up to 3 years or the age limit, whichever is earlier; not entitled to any leave or benefits. Professional indemnity policy is required: minimum Rs.20 Lakhs per annum for General Surgeons and obstetrics, Rs.10 Lakhs for Dentist, Radiologist, Microbiologist etc. A copy of the premium and receipt is due within 7 days of engagement.

Senior Resident (03 Year): engagement initially for one year, extendable annually up to 3 years; security deposit of Rs.30,000/- by DD/Bankers Cheque in favour of 'ESIC A/c No 1' payable at Tirunelveli; admissible to all kinds of leave as per the Residency Scheme of Government of India as approved by ESIC. Senior Resident (01 Year): tenure maximum one year or till the regular medical officer joins, whichever is earlier; security deposit of Rs.15,000/-; leave of 2.5 days per month (working), with no advance leave and no encashment. For both Senior Resident posts, the deposit is appropriated towards administrative cost if the candidate resigns or terminates the contract within nine months of commencement; private practice is not allowed, as Non Practicing allowance is received. All posts: contract commences after submitting an agreement signed on a Rs.100/- stamp paper; the engagement may be terminated by either side on one month's notice; absence of 15 days without permission amounts to abandonment of engagement.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The age limit is counted on the date of interview. The posts and their conditions are as follows. For Senior Resident (01 Year), the candidate must produce the internship completion certificate at the time of interview and should be registered with NMC or Tamil Nadu State Medical Council. The notice also says that if a PG qualified doctor is not available, MBBS doctors with two years of experience, one year of it in the concerned specialty from a Government or private hospital (not a private clinic), can be selected for the 01 Year Senior Resident post at Pay level 10 (marked against Obstetrics & Gynaecology*). The total is 30 posts: 10 + 16 + 4. Five posts are horizontally reserved for the PwBD category in identified posts. The notice says that if reserved candidates (SC, ST, OBC and EWS) are not available, vacancies will be filled by the available meritorious candidate for a period of 44 days at the sole discretion of the Appointing Authority. For Sl.No.1 (Specialist), priority will be given to Full Time Super Specialist/Full Time Specialist.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under his/her supervision in that specialty discipline. Responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under his supervision in that specialty discipline. Minimum working hour is 16 hours per week (minimum 4 hours per day as assigned by the Medical Superintendent). Available on call 24x7, in addition to the minimum hours. Additional hours of work are to be justified by the Medical Superintendent. Duties as assigned by the Medical Superintendent, including emergency duties assigned by the MS or his representatives. Duties and responsibilities as fixed by the Government from time to time, including such work as may be needed in the legitimate interest of patient care in the hospital. Duties as assigned by the Medical Superintendent, including emergency duties or any other duties assigned by the MS or his representatives.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the prescribed format (Annexure I of the notice). Two recent passport size photographs. Two sets of testimonials along with the originals for verification: proof of date of birth; SSLC/Matriculation certificate or equivalent; certificate of qualification; certificate of registration with the concerned Medical Council; caste certificate; experience certificate. No Objection Certificate from the employer, for candidates in Government service. Valid OBC certificate in Annexure "A" (DoPT OM No.36036/2/2013-Estt(Res) dated 30.05.2014) for OBC candidates claiming reservation or age relaxation; EWS certificate in the Government prescribed format, valid on the date of interview, for EWS candidates applying for Senior Resident (03 Year). Valid Disability Certificate issued by a Medical Board constituted by the Central or State Government, for PwBD candidates.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report to the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Vannarpettai, Tirunelveli, at the Conference Hall, 1st Floor, between 9.00 AM and 10.30 AM for verification of documents (originals and a self-attested set). The walk-in interview follows. The decision of the selection board is final, and no further correspondence is entertained. Walk-in interview applies to the vacancies still available on the date of interview, and the vacancies available are uploaded on the website for the respective months.

faq.question: Q1. What are the walk-in interview dates at ESIC Hospital Tirunelveli?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are on 27.11.2026 and 16.12.2026. The advertisement is valid up to 31.12.2026 or till the date of notice of closure, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Registration is from 9.00 AM to 10.30 AM at the Conference Hall, 1st Floor, ESIC Hospital, Vannarpettai, Tirunelveli.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 30 posts: 10 Full Time/Part Time Specialist, 16 Senior Resident (03 Year) and 4 Senior Resident (01 Year) at Pay level 10. The Medical Superintendent may vary the vacancies.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Senior Resident (03 Year)?
faq.answer: MBBS with PG Degree or Diploma or Equivalent in the concerned specialty from a Recognized University. The decision of the Medical Superintendent on this is final.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The limit is not exceeding 67 years for Specialists, 45 years for Senior Resident (03 Year) and 30 years for Senior Resident (01 Year), counted on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Full Time Specialist and Senior Resident (03 Year) get consolidated remuneration of Rs.1,42,514/-; Senior Resident (01 Year) gets Rs.1,19,082/-. Part Time Specialist is 60,000 for 16 hrs/week (4 days/week) + 15,000 (Rs.800/hr for every additional hour above 16 hours/week).

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I carry?
faq.answer: Carry the filled Annexure I form, two passport size photographs, and two sets of testimonials with originals: proof of date of birth, SSLC/Matriculation certificate, qualification certificate, medical council registration, caste certificate and experience certificate.

faq.question: Q8. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are on contract. Full Time Specialist and Senior Resident (03 Year) can be extended yearly up to 3 years, while Senior Resident (01 Year) is for a maximum of one year. Selected candidates have no claim for regularization.

faq.question: Q9. Is a security deposit required?
faq.answer: Yes, for Senior Resident posts only: Rs.30,000/- for Senior Resident (03 Year) and Rs.15,000/- for Senior Resident (01 Year), by DD/Bankers Cheque in favour of 'ESIC A/c No 1' payable at Tirunelveli.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is admissible for the walk-in interview or for joining the post.
